title: 8MM Bullet
desc: Karthik, an honest policeman, chases a criminal mastermind during which he loses his service gun. Trouble begins when the gun lands in the hands of a common man who uses it to kill people.

title: #Single
desc: Vijay enjoys his single life until he falls for Purva. While pursuing her, he discovers that Harini, his friend, loves him and inadvertently gets caught in a love triangle.

title: Dana Kayonu
desc: A cowherd loves Jummi, the village beauty, as well as his loyal bull. However, his life changes when a multinational company offers him a huge fortune in exchange for his animal.

title: Bhajarangi
desc: A cruel god-man rules and harasses the people in a village. Jeevan, who comes to the village to learn about his ancestors, ends up bravely fighting against him to save the villagers.

title: Drishya 2
desc: Haunted by the guilt over the murder, Rajendra and his family are thrown into chaos when new clues surface, forcing them into a desperate race to evade the police.

title: Grahana
desc: Honnarathi, a young Brahmin woman, faces severe community backlash for remaining unmarried. Consequently, her parents abandon her, leaving her to navigate numerous complex challenges alone.

title: Ijjodu
desc: Anand, a journalist, travels to a village to study more about architecture. He meets Channi, a devadasi, and learns details about the secrets of her dark past.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Take It Easy
desc: Dhanraj, a middle-class man, and his family struggle to navigate through their financial issues. Soon, he sets out on a quest to buy a car despite not being able to afford it.

title: Melkote Manja
desc: Jaggesh, always in debt, finds unexpected allies among his debtors, who hilariously come to his rescue. Set in picturesque Melkote, it's a fun watch!
